problems.title: Make a science label

context: A science class needs a program to print a topic label for its work.
question.command: Write a program that does the following.
requirements: Ask for the science topic.
Display Science followed by the topic name.
Leave one space between Science and the topic.

blocks.text: Store the topic as text so its letters are kept for the label.
topic = input("Topic ")
Join Science, a space and the topic. The test topic Plants gives the complete label Science Plants.

label = "Science " + topic
print(label)

problems.solution:
topic = input("Topic ")
label = "Science " + topic
print(label)

problems.title: Find a temperature rise

context: A science class needs a program to report the temperature rise during an experiment. Both temperature readings are in degrees Celsius.
question.command: Write a program that does the following.
requirements: Ask for the starting temperature.
Ask for the final temperature.
Display the temperature rise in degrees.

blocks.text: Keep the starting and final temperature readings in separate variables.

start = int(input("Starting temperature "))
end = int(input("Final temperature "))
Subtract the start from the end. The test readings rise from 18 to 23, giving a rise of 5 degrees.

rise = end - start
print(f"Rise {rise} degrees")

problems.solution:
start = int(input("Starting temperature "))
end = int(input("Final temperature "))
rise = end - start
print(f"Rise {rise} degrees")

problems.title: Share seeds between trays

context: A school garden needs a program to plan an equal share of seeds for its planting trays. Seeds must stay whole, and some may be left over.
question.command: Write a program that does the following.
requirements: Ask for the number of seeds.
Ask for the number of trays.
Display how many seeds each tray receives.
Display how many seeds are left over.

blocks.text: Keep the seed count and tray count as whole numbers.

seeds = int(input("Seeds "))
trays = int(input("Trays "))
Use whole groups for the share and a remainder for the seeds left. The test gives 4 seeds per tray and 1 left.

each = seeds // trays
left = seeds % trays
print(f"Seeds per tray {each}")
print(f"Seeds left {left}")

problems.solution:
seeds = int(input("Seeds "))
trays = int(input("Trays "))
each = seeds // trays
left = seeds % trays
print(f"Seeds per tray {each}")
print(f"Seeds left {left}")

problems.title: Total the collected water

context: A science class needs a program to report the total water collected in four containers. The amounts are 3, 5, 2 and 4 litres.

requirements: Use the four supplied water amounts.
Display their combined amount.
Show Water total before the answer and litres after it.

steps.title: Store the amounts and starting total

blocks.text: Store the four container amounts and set the running total to 0.

amounts = [3, 5, 2, 4]
total = 0
Add each stored amount without losing the earlier amounts. The four test containers hold 14 litres together.

problems.solution:

problems.title: Show five times-table facts

blocks.text: Store the chosen number that will be used in every multiplication fact.
